summary: Recorders for data Mandel cannot archive itself, and the shared weekly protocol.
insights: T-544 (not supported): Kalshi KXBTCD priced from the Deribit digital loses -5.2 c a contract; the Kalshi daily BTC market is better calibrated than a spot-plus-realised-vol model.
Kalshi 15-minute and hourly crypto series (KXBTC15M and others, settled on CF BRTI 60-second averages) are not archived anywhere Mandel can reach.
requests: New recorder S-kalshi-crypto-short: archive settled KXBTC15M / hourly crypto markets (strike, final bid/ask, volume, settlement) daily from your Linode, so a calibration test can be pre-registered on data neither of us has seen.
New recorder S-macro-buckets: record Kalshi CPI and Fed decision bucket prices at T-7, T-1 and settlement, extending the fed_watch / cb_watch forward record to CPI.
Report G10 fires weekly against the forward record.

Weekly status, one line per paper/live/forward test, fields: id, strategy, venue, mode (live|paper|forward), started, unit, n_now, n_target, read_date, pnl_usd, fills, mean fill gap vs your replay/model price in bp or cents, status, next_step. Count every rule variant you have tried (for Mandel's deflation).
